Sam's Club U.S.

· Solid comp sales, led by food and consumables as well as increases in transactions and unit volumes

· Gained dollar and unit market share in grocery

· Growth in eCommerce sales of 17% led by delivery and curbside

· Strong growth in membership income, up 10.0%, with record total membership and Plus penetration at quarter end

· Advertising business- up 11% with record number of advertisers investing with MAP

Comp sales for the 13-week and 52-week periods ended January 26th, 2024 compared to the 13-week and 52-week periods ended January 27th, 2023, and excludes fuel. See Supplemental Financial Information for additional information.

Our global advertising business is recorded in either net sales or as a reduction to cost of sales, depending on the nature of the advertising arrangement. NP - Not provided
